name: The Valley
description: One day they are living the glam party life at SUR with Lisa Vanderpump and the next they're married and dealing with homeownership and children. From bottle service to baby bottles, close friends and reality stars find their way out of the young and fast life of the Hollywood lights. They are getting ready to grow up and have moved to the serenity of The Valley, where they navigate bustling businesses, rocky relationships and feisty friendships.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E1)
videos.overview: On The Valley After Show season 2 episode 1... (PART 1) The Valley cast weigh in on the extent of Jax Taylor’s friendship with Julian Sensley, and Jax reveals where they stand today.  (PART 2)Lala Kent talks about finding out about Brittany Cartwright's last boyfriend, Michelle Saniei discusses Kristen Doute and Jesse Lally's newfound friendship, and Tom Schwartz reveals where he stands with Tom Sandoval today

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E2)
videos.overview: On The Valley After Show Season 2 Episode 2...  (PART 1) Jax Taylor opens up about his journey to recovery, and Brittany Cartwright and The Valley cast reveal their opinions on Jax insulting Brittany throughout their relationship. (PART 2) Michelle Saniei and Jesse Lally reveal the difficulties of raising their child together after their split, Jesse reacts to Michelle moving in with her new boyfriend, and Zack Wickham gives an update on his own relationship.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E3)
videos.overview: On The Valley After Show Season 2 Episode 3... (PART 1) Jesse Lally opens up on how the billionaire rumor started about Michelle Saniei, and Danny Booko and Jasmine Goode discusse the Halloween incident. (PART 2) Michelle Saniei digs into Jesse Lally's spending habits, and Jax Taylor admits it "feels good" to discuss his issue after hiding it, and The Valley cast give their opinions on the infamous Boys' Chat.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E4)
videos.overview: On season 2 episode 4 of The Valley After Show...  (PART 1) Jax Taylor reveals what he wanted from Brittany Cartwright during his time in rehab, and Brittany discusses her opinion on the matter. (PART 2) Zack Wickham and Janet Caperna discuss their evolving relationship, and Brittany Cartwright's involvement in their drama.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E5)
videos.overview: On season 2 episode 5 of The Valley After Show... (PART 1) Michelle Saniei and Jesse Lally reveal details of their relationship while they were married, and Jax Taylor and the cast react to his new diagnosis. (PART 2) The Valley cast reveal why Danny Booko missing dinner escalated into drama.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E6)
videos.overview: On season 2 episode 6 of The Valley After Show... (PART 1) The cast is split on whether Nia Booko is wrong to avoid the problem, and Nia and Danny Booko feel attacked. (PART 2) Janet Caperna discusses feeling shut down by Nia Booko, Luke Broderick shares details on engagement ring shopping for Kristen Doute and his ideal forever home, and Michelle Saniei reveals challenges navigating a new relationship mid-divorce.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E7)
videos.overview: On season 2 episode 7 of The Valley After Show... (PART 1) The Valley cast delves into theories surrounding Jason Caperna's wedding ring rumor and give their take as to whether they think Jason is Janet Caperna's puppet. (PART 2) Brittany Cartwright is frustrated Jax Taylor didn’t keep up with the mortgage payments or consult her about his new lease, and Jesse Lally reveals whether he still has feelings for Michelle Saniei.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E8)
videos.overview: On season 2 episode 8 of The Valley After Show... (PART 1) Brittany Cartwright reveals she has a “sex drawer”, Jason and Janet Caperna discuss why the wedding ring rumor hurt them, and The Valley cast talks quirky obsessions and collectibles. (PART 2) Jax Taylor talks about starting his own podcast, and the group gives their take on Jasmine Goode’s beach outburst to Jason and Janet Caperna.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E9)
videos.overview: On Season 2 Episode 9 of The Valley After Show... (PART 1) Brittany Cartwright and The Valley cast piece together if Jax Taylor tricked the rehab facility, and Jax admits to watching Brittany from rehab through the house cameras. (PART 2) Jesse Lally draws the parallels between his divorce and Jax Taylor and Brittany Cartwright’s, and Brittany talks about packing Jax’s things in trash bags and filing for divorce.

videos.title: The Valley After Show (S2 E10)
videos.overview: On Season 2 Episode 10 of The Valley After Show... (PART 1) Jax Taylor opens up about the shocking moment he was served divorce papers with Tom Schwartz by his side, The Valley cast weigh in on Jax’s alleged burner account, and Brittany Cartwright shares some exciting renovations to her home. (PART 2) Zack Wickham discusses being blacklisted from Jax’s bar, Jax Taylor opens up about his anger issues, and Tom Schwartz welcomes Jax to the neighborhood.

videos.title: Welcome to the Valley
videos.overview: “Vanderpump Rules” alums Jax, Brittany and Kristen have all traded in their wild nights at SUR for a suburban life in the Valley. In the series premiere, their couple-friends Danny and Nia are trying to juggle three kids under 2 years old. Jesse and Michelle are navigating the complicated world of being both toddler parents and business partners. When Brittany goes all out, throwing a lavish birthday party for best friend Janet, things take a turn for the worse when the group focuses less on the festivities and begin judging Kristen’s life-altering decisions.

videos.title: Tit for Tat
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Janet’s birthday party, Nia is angry about Jax pantsing her husband, Danny, in front of the group. Jesse finds himself in hot water with Kristen and Luke over an inappropriate action. Jax’s guy’s night comes crashing down when he invites a surprise visitor who blindsides Luke. While across town, Kristen unleashes an accusation against Michelle that could ruin their friendship forever.

videos.title: Doubting Doute
videos.overview: While everyone turns against Kristen for the accusations she hurled at Michelle during Girl’s Night, Brittany tries to help her understand the impact of her actions. Jax interviews bartenders for his new bar. Jesse and Michelle discover how fractured their relationship really is during their first marital counseling session. Janet and Jason stress about not feeling prepared for their new baby. A lavish Capri-themed dinner party is brought to a halt when Kristen is forced to relive one of the most difficult moments of her life.

videos.title: Capri Chaos
videos.overview: Jesse and Michelle deal with the aftermath of their Capri-themed dinner party, leaving the group on shaky ground with Kristen. Brittany opens up to Jax about their lack of intimacy. Luke plans a special date for Kristen with the help of Danny and Brittany. Janet invites the group to a charity gala where Zack tries to get Kristen, Jesse and Michelle to squash the beef between them.

videos.title: The 'D' Word
videos.overview: The ladies retreat to Malibu for a girls’ night while leaving the boys to daddy daycare. Michelle opens up to Brittany that she isn’t sure she wants to stay with Jesse. Brittany shares that she isn’t getting any intimacy from Jax. The ladies are concerned for Nia as she struggles with postpartum depression. The old Jax returns as he stirs up some interesting rumors about one friend in the group.

videos.title: Congrats on Your Hair Loss
videos.overview: Jax tries to get Jasmine to do his dirty work and find out if rumors about Michelle are true. Kristen begins to worry after a negative pregnancy test if she’ll ever have a baby. Brittany sees the progress at the bar for the first time after feeling excluded. Luke begins to feel homesick. The group gathers for the launch of a hair-loss product Jax is endorsing as long-simmering tensions come to an explosive head.

videos.title: The #1 Gossip of the Group
videos.overview: Janet and Jason confront Jax about cheating rumors. Luke begins to realize that dating Kristen isn’t as easy as he thought. Nia continues to struggle with postpartum blues while Brittany and Jax fail to get their mojo back. Kristen is labeled public enemy #1 after an explosive fight at the Mondrian.

videos.title: The Invite Fight
videos.overview: Brittany and Jax's struggles continue; Janet and Jason host a dinner party at their house and invite everyone except Kristen and Luke, further pushing a rift in the group; Jasmine tries to get to the bottom of who started the rumors about Michelle.

videos.title: The Big Bear Bombshell
videos.overview: Jesse returns from his spiritual retreat; Kristen, Luke and Zack are left behind as the group heads to Big Bear; Jax finally confronts Michelle about the infidelity rumors.

videos.title: Babymoon Mayhem
videos.overview: Jesse finally learns about the rumors swirling about his wife, Michelle; The guys come together to support Danny, who is feeling the mounting pressures of fatherhood.

videos.title: Darkside Danny
videos.overview: The women throw a surprise baby shower for Janet; The whole group indulges in a dinner for the final night in Big Bear dressed as their partner's fantasy.

videos.title: Opening Bars, Closing Chapters
videos.overview: The group celebrates the opening of Jax and Brittany's new bar; Janet comes face to face with Zack for the first time since her babymoon; the truth about Jax and Brittany's and Michelle and Jesse's marriages is revealed.

videos.title: Separation Anxiety
videos.overview: As summer approaches, tensions are on the rise in the Valley; Jax and Brittany continue picking up the pieces from their separation; Jesse and Michelle juggle co-parenting their daughter, Isabella, while starting new relationships.

videos.title: Checking In
videos.overview: Jax's life comes under tough scrutiny as he's confronted about his recent behavior; he finally admits he's at rock bottom and elects to seek professional help; Zack tries to find stability in his friendship with Brittany.

videos.title: The Billionaire and the Boys' Chat
videos.overview: Michelle and Jesse's divorce takes an ugly turn when a rumor about Michelle begins to spread; Brittany tries to put the pieces of her life back together after Jax checks into a mental health facility; Luke reveals a major life milestone to Danny.

videos.title: The Circle of Strife
videos.overview: Jesse and Kristen arrange a getaway to Santa Barbara hoping everyone can find peace and heal; Zack and Janet sit down for a heart-to-heart conversation; Jax, still struggling with his emotions, makes his presence felt in Santa Barbara.

videos.title: Grapes of Wrath
videos.overview: The group's Santa Barbara retreat continues to unravel; emotions escalate between Jesse and Michelle leading to an explosive argument; Nia is blindsided when Zack tells her that some of the group has been talking behind her back.

videos.title: Behind Closed Pantry Doors
videos.overview: The Santa Barbara trip comes to a dramatic end as Nia fights back against Brittany, Jasmine and Janet; back in L.A., Jesse seeks guidance as he hopes to rebound from his wine country fight with Michelle.

videos.title: Ring Around the Rumor
videos.overview: Jason confronts Danny about his drinking as Danny looks to make amends with Jasmine and Melissa; Kristen attempts to defend the Bookos and in the process, a rumor about the Capernas emerges.

videos.title: The Biggest Snake in the Grass
videos.overview: Tensions boil between Jasmine, Janet and Jason; Zack starts to realize that his friendship with Brittany has shifted; the rumor Kristen started continues to wreak havoc in the friend group; Brittany uncovers a shocking breach of privacy by Jax.

videos.title: When One Door Forecloses
videos.overview: Kristen and Luke's housewarming takes a turn; Brittany prepares for Jax's return by meeting with a divorce attorney; Jasmine and Melissa try to mend things with Jason and Janet; Danny is accused of overindulging again.

videos.title: You've Been Served
videos.overview: Jax becomes upset when he finds out about the party at Britt's; the guys take Jax to a dinner that leads to a confrontation between Jason and Danny; the tension between Nia and Janet comes to a head; Jax is blindsided by a special delivery.

videos.title: El Coyote Ugly
videos.overview: Luke finalizes plans for a trip to Hawaii where he plans to propose to Kristen; Janet, Michelle, Kristen and Nia butt heads during a girl's night out; Jesse confronts Aaron about the timeline of his relationship with Michelle.

videos.title: Will You Maui Me?
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to Kristen, a fishing trip Luke planned is where he plans to pop the question; Brittany feels hurt and left out when she learns she isn't a part of Kristen's proposal; Janet threatens to leave the trip early.

videos.title: The Cruise From Hell
videos.overview: Jax spoils Kristen and Luke's engagement after Brittany inadvertently reveals the news to him; Kristen and Zack are fed up with Brittany always choosing Janet over them; all hell breaks loose when Janet and Kristen reach their breaking points.

videos.title: Making Up Is Hard to Do
videos.overview: In the wake of the cruise from hell, Janet struggles with insults Kristen threw at her; Danny and Nia look at a house as they get closer to their decision on having a fourth child; Jax and Brittany have an argument when discussing co-parenting.

videos.title: There's No Zen in Resentment
videos.overview: Jesse and Michelle experience a breakthrough in their relationship; Kristen comes to terms with her fertility journey; conflict takes the spotlight at Michelle's Zen party; Jax comes clean about his battles.

videos.title: Reunion (1)
videos.overview: Kristen and Nia relive their fertility journeys; Jesse and Michelle clash over the their divorce.

videos.title: Reunion (2)
videos.overview: Jax opens up about his sobriety journey and continues to butt heads with Brittany.

videos.title: Reunion (3)
videos.overview: Kristen and Luke reminisce over their engagement; Bookos and the Capernas' argument threatens.

videos.title: You Can't Sip With Us
videos.overview: Danny and Nia juggle four under four, while Kristen and Luke don't see eye-to-eye as they transition to first-time parenthood; Brittany tries to get her sparkle back in a new relationship, but Zack worries they're moving too fast; when Kristen and Nia co-host a Sip and See event, Michelle becomes anxious when Jesse's girlfriend Lacy surprisingly shows up.

videos.title: Snip Snip
videos.overview: Lala invites most of the group to celebrate her daughter Sosa's first birthday, leaving some feeling excluded; Janet tries to make amends with a few members of the group; Tom and Michelle's bond continues to grow.

videos.title: The Santa Clarita Trail
videos.overview: Brittany takes the first step toward regaining her self-confidence with a mommy makeover consultation; Jasmine's growing friendship with Lala is tested on a girls' night out, leaving Michelle in the middle.

videos.title: Mariposa Momma
videos.overview: Danny and Nia continue to struggle with their newborn daughter refusing a bottle; as Kristen grapples with postpartum blues, her relationship with Luke is tested when their first date night out without Kaia turns into a disaster.

videos.title: The Hive Mentality
videos.overview: Janet's game night olive branch yields mixed results; Jesse gives Lacy a divorce update in hopes of taking things to the next level; Kristen and Luke continue to struggle with their communication.

videos.title: All Aboard!
videos.overview: Tom introduces his crush, Kiana, to his friends. The group takes a train to San Diego and Janet tries to build a stronger friendship with Zack. Danny starts to lose his patience with Nia. Kristen and Luke struggle on their first trip as new parents. Michelle and Lala share an emotional moment.

videos.title: Triggers and Tiaras
videos.overview: The San Diego trip continues with Lacy’s arrival, which causes chaos, particularly with Michelle. Kristen struggles to quell her postpartum frustration towards Luke. The group holds a drag pageant where Danny and Nia’s relationship is put to the test when Danny behaves out of line.

videos.title: Miss Behavior
videos.overview: Nia struggles to deal with Danny’s antics during a drag pageant. Jason suffers a traumatic injury. Lala questions why Kristen blindly takes up for the Bookos.

videos.title: 'Til Debt Do Us Part
videos.overview: Kristen and Luke work to reconnect; Michelle opens up to Lala about the financial strain of her impending divorce and emotions run high when she surprises Jesse with divorce papers to sign.

videos.title: Red Flags and White Claws
videos.overview: Zack's roommate moves out, leaving an empty apartment for him and Benji to see what living together could be like. While Brittany recovers from her mommy makeover at home, red flags start to arise with her new boyfriend, Brandon. Jasmine confronts Zack for his lack of support. Jesse feels Brittany is not held accountable for her actions. At Zack’s housewarming party, Danny hides the truth when confronted.

videos.title: Friendships Shaken, Not Stirred
videos.overview: Zack invites everyone on a getaway to Mexico; Brittany drops shocking news about Brandon; Tom hosts a Bond-themed party where relationships are tested when Lala confronts Nia, Janet takes on Luke and Jesse leaves Michelle in tears.

videos.title: Schwartzapalooza
videos.overview: Zack breaks down about his future with Benji. Benji pokes a hole in Danny’s story. Brittany calls out Kristen for protecting Nia’s feelings over hers. On a group trip to Mexico, Kristen’s travel anxiety gets the best of her. Luke reveals his uncertainty about the future of their relationship.

videos.title: Liked and Loaded
videos.overview: Schwartz’s birthday party erupts into chaos after Lala calls out Danny’s social media behavior. Zack’s temper flares over the group’s treatment of Danny. Luke and Kristen continue to clash. On a day trip to Sayulita, tensions come to a head between Nia and Janet.

videos.title: Hips Don't Lie
videos.overview: Kristen is accused of throwing her best friends under the bus. Tension builds between Danny and Nia while out with the group for Zack’s birthday. Michelle struggles watching Jesse be affectionate with Lacy. Zack ends up in the emergency room.

videos.title: It's My Birthday & I'll Cry If I Want To
videos.overview: Michelle and Lacy get emotional as they attempt to move forward; Jesse reveals a secret to Kristen about her future with Luke; Janet opens up to Lala about her past; tensions hit a high at Danny's birthday dinner.

videos.title: Balls Voyage
videos.overview: Lala celebrates her 7-year sober anniversary while also dealing with the passing of her dog, Lily. Kristen and Luke struggle with the aftermath of Mexico and what's next for their relationship. Danny gets a vasectomy while Nia is away judging.

videos.title: Guilt Tripping
videos.overview: Jesse and Michelle take a major step with their divorce. Zack struggles with the decision to have kids with his boyfriend, Benji. Kristen and Luke meet with a couples' therapist to mixed results. At a mommy makeover photoshoot, Brittany and Lala question Kristen’s motivation when it comes to Zack and Nia.

videos.title: The Valley of the Damned
videos.overview: Drama erupts as secrets spill, friendships crack, and accusations fly at Brittany's party.

videos.title: Reunion Part 1
videos.overview: Tensions run high as the group from The Valley comes together. Kristen and Nia reflect on their postpartum journeys and marriages now that their daughters are a year old. Brittany comes to terms with her dating picker being off, while Michelle addresses her love life being in the headlines. Zack calls out Brittany for not having his back, and when Lacy joins the reunion stage, things quickly take a turn with Michelle.

videos.title: Reunion Part 2
videos.overview: The reunion continues as Kristen and Luke give an update on their relationship and marriage plans, while Lacy and Michelle continue to disagree. Despite their ongoing beef, Janet and Danny share a heartfelt moment as they touch on their experiences with backlash on social media.

videos.title: Reunion Part 3
videos.overview: The reunion concludes as Lala stands firm and challenges the Bookos about Danny's behavior. Kristen breaks down in tears over her previous comments. Janet opens up about her past trauma and how it affects the way she walks through life.
